summary: All obligations in the original-graph single-triangle exclusion and its necessary trace/normal-form dependency chain are discharged; same-family paper judgment remains provisional.
theorem_statement: Every simple undirected graph on 59 vertices with maximum degree at most 8, a path of length one or two between every distinct pair, and actual N15 matching B rows at all zero-triangle vertices cannot have exactly one triangle.
excluded_dependency_scope: H5 line 155 optional short-cycle corollary, N4/N5, any general H5 exclusion, and any derivation of N15 from arbitrary n59 hypotheses.

counterexample_attempts: Omitted edges in complete triangle-row support
Active endpoints of internal light pairs
Inactive endpoints of cross light pairs
Orientation or double counting in heavy endpoint capacity

exact_checks.role: Supplementary; analytic original-graph proof is the basis of the verdict.
